description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayAgentChannel component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing delivery logic, channel fallback behavior, and initialization normalization.

classes.name: GatewayAgentChannelTests
classes.description: A set of unit test functions for GatewayAgentChannel, verifying delivery rules, channel fallback behavior, and proper normalization of raw input values.

methods.name: should deliver blocks web chat
methods.description: Test that webchat channel's shouldDeliver method returns false for both true and false inputs.

methods.name: should deliver allows last and provider channels
methods.description: Test that various channels (last, whatsapp, telegram, googlechat, bluebubbles) return true for shouldDeliver when input is true, and last returns false when input is false.

methods.name: init raw normalizes and falls back to last
methods.description: Test the GatewayAgentChannel(raw:) initializer to ensure it normalizes input strings and defaults to 'last' for invalid inputs.
